decisions.reason: The Magento shop template directly complements the firm's hosting and online-shop services for agencies and shop operators and supports cross-selling in a growing core market.

A responsive website template is close to the firm's established web project business and broadens a practical offer for agencies, freelancers, and business customers at relatively low incremental effort.
Premium customer support fits the firm's main competitive strength in expert service and should improve customer retention and account value.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's R&D and operations capabilities and matches its strategy of reducing recurring technical work for customers.

The data processing contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's core hosting and technical support offer, so management would likely reallocate resources to more defensible platform and service innovations.
